purpose.summary: Add the read-only node-storage foundation for a future upstream-compatible confirmed transaction query, without opening a route or duplicating transaction bodies in Chronik storage.
scope: Resolve an indexed block identity only when it is on the active chain and re-check that identity after disk I/O.
Read canonical block and undo data through the inherited Bitcoin Static storage primitives.
Select the exact transaction and positionally bind every spent coin to its corresponding input.
Fail closed on unavailable or pruned data, identity contradictions, incomplete undo data and concurrent reorganization.
exclusions: No HTTP, RPC, Rust bridge, transaction response, spent-by lookup, mempool query, UTXO query, history, websocket, plugin or wallet surface is added.
No consensus, validation, activation, chain-selection, P2P, network-identity or mainnet parameter behavior changes.
No duplicate transaction-body database, private source, history, operator data, incoming evidence, binary, cache, build output or host-specific path is tracked.

scenarios.command: Run the existing deep-reorganization scenario and the reader identity-contradiction unit cases.
expected_results: Observer contradictions remain isolated and an active-chain identity change cannot produce a silent orphan transaction result.
failure_conditions: Orphan result, stale observer state, node-authority effect, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

limitations: This slice exposes no public transaction route; the Rust bridge, canonical transaction protobuf and HTTP integration remain later work.
Historical transaction reads require the relevant canonical blk and rev data to remain available; pruned or unavailable data fails the query.
Spent-by, mempool, histories, UTXOs, websockets, plugins and independent public reproduction remain outside this slice.
The local macOS result is a component observation only; public CI and review are still pending.
counterevidence: The first native build attempt found async-trait 0.1.92 absent from the isolated offline Cargo cache; a locked fetch into the task-specific cache resolved the declared dependency without changing source or lock bytes.
The first native Rust bridge build could not discover libclang automatically; binding CHRONIK_LIBCLANG_DIR to the Xcode toolchain completed the build without changing source.
The reader deliberately returns no result when canonical block or undo data is missing instead of falling back to a partial or duplicate Chronik record.
